artifacts.schema:
CREATE TABLE artifacts(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
                media_type TEXT NOT NULL,size INTEGER NOT NULL)

current_revisions.schema:
CREATE TABLE current_revisions(record_type TEXT NOT NULL,key_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
                revision INTEGER NOT NULL,record_ref TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(record_type,key_ref))

inputs.schema: CREATE TABLE inputs(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,data TEXT NOT NULL)

library_selection_members.schema:
CREATE TABLE library_selection_members(
            selection_ref TEXT NOT NULL,read_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY(selection_ref,read_ref))

material_annotations.schema:
CREATE TABLE material_annotations(
            parse_key TEXT NOT NULL,record_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,entry_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
            entry_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,byte_start INTEGER NOT NULL,byte_end INTEGER NOT NULL,
            preview TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(parse_key,record_ordinal,entry_kind,entry_ordinal))

material_component_spans.schema:
CREATE TABLE material_component_spans(
            member_ref TEXT NOT NULL,component TEXT NOT NULL,part INTEGER NOT NULL,
            chunk_index INTEGER NOT NULL,start INTEGER NOT NULL,end INTEGER NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY(member_ref,component,part))

material_errors.schema:
CREATE TABLE material_errors(
            parse_key TEXT NOT NULL,error_index INTEGER NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY(parse_key,error_index))

material_members.schema:
CREATE TABLE material_members(
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,parse_key TEXT NOT NULL,ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,
            collection_ref TEXT,data TEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE(parse_key,ordinal))

material_name_counts.schema:
CREATE TABLE material_name_counts(
            parse_key TEXT NOT NULL,name TEXT NOT NULL,next_occurrence INTEGER NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY(parse_key,name))

material_pack_chunks.schema:
CREATE TABLE material_pack_chunks(
            parse_key TEXT NOT NULL,chunk_index INTEGER NOT NULL,artifact_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY(parse_key,chunk_index))

problem.schema: CREATE TABLE problem(singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),data TEXT NOT NULL)

proposals.schema:
CREATE TABLE proposals(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,record_type TEXT NOT NULL,
                key_ref TEXT NOT NULL,expected_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL)

provider_job_failures.schema:
CREATE TABLE provider_job_failures (
            job_ref TEXT PRIMARY KEY, data TEXT NOT NULL)

provider_jobs.schema:
CREATE TABLE provider_jobs (
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, operation_key TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, request TEXT NOT NULL,
            state TEXT NOT NULL, remote_id TEXT, submission TEXT, latest_status TEXT,
            result TEXT, error_code TEXT)

reasoning_commits.schema:
CREATE TABLE reasoning_commits(operation_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                signature TEXT NOT NULL,result TEXT NOT NULL)

record_roots.schema:
CREATE TABLE record_roots(record_ref TEXT NOT NULL,target_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY(record_ref,target_ref))

records.schema:
CREATE TABLE records(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,record_type TEXT NOT NULL,
                origin TEXT NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL)

runtime_actions.schema:
CREATE TABLE runtime_actions (
          run_id TEXT NOT NULL, episode_id TEXT NOT NULL, decision_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
          action TEXT NOT NULL, result TEXT, credit REAL, timing TEXT,
          PRIMARY KEY(run_id,episode_id,decision_index))

runtime_episodes.schema:
CREATE TABLE runtime_episodes (
          run_id TEXT NOT NULL, episode_id TEXT NOT NULL, path TEXT NOT NULL,
          request TEXT NOT NULL, initial_credit REAL NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL,
          completion TEXT, archive TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(run_id,episode_id))

runtime_estimation_contexts.schema:
CREATE TABLE runtime_estimation_contexts (
          run_id TEXT NOT NULL, episode_id TEXT NOT NULL, decision_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
          data TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(run_id,episode_id,decision_index))

runtime_forms.schema:
CREATE TABLE runtime_forms (
          run_id TEXT NOT NULL, episode_id TEXT NOT NULL, facts TEXT NOT NULL,
          form TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(run_id,episode_id))

runtime_model_calls.schema:
CREATE TABLE runtime_model_calls (
          run_id TEXT NOT NULL, episode_id TEXT NOT NULL, call_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
          purpose TEXT NOT NULL, request TEXT NOT NULL, response TEXT, timing TEXT,
          PRIMARY KEY(run_id,episode_id,call_index))

runtime_observations.schema:
CREATE TABLE runtime_observations (
          run_id TEXT NOT NULL, episode_id TEXT NOT NULL, unit_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
          observation TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(run_id,episode_id,unit_index))

runtime_report_attempts.schema:
CREATE TABLE runtime_report_attempts (
          run_id TEXT NOT NULL, parent_episode_id TEXT NOT NULL,
          decision_index INTEGER NOT NULL, delivery_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
          child_episode_id TEXT NOT NULL, contract TEXT NOT NULL,
          form TEXT, failure TEXT,
          PRIMARY KEY(run_id,parent_episode_id,decision_index))

runtime_runs.schema:
CREATE TABLE runtime_runs (
          run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, settings TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL,
          summary TEXT, started_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

runtime_timed_commissions.schema:
CREATE TABLE runtime_timed_commissions (
          run_id TEXT NOT NULL, parent_episode_id TEXT NOT NULL, decision_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
          selection_digest TEXT NOT NULL, child_episode_id TEXT NOT NULL,
          scheduled_at REAL NOT NULL, due_at REAL NOT NULL, fired_at REAL, returned_at REAL,
          PRIMARY KEY(run_id,parent_episode_id,decision_index))

tool_operations.schema:
CREATE TABLE tool_operations (
